factor_dict.WQ_INTRADAY:
ao = d['open'] * d['adj_factor']; ac = d['close'] * d['adj_factor']; ah = d['high'] * d['adj_factor']; al = d['low'] * d['adj_factor']
out = (ao - ac) / (ah - al + 0.001)
factor_dict.WQ_VWAP_DEV:
avwap = (d['amount'] / (d['vol'] + 1e-12)) * d['adj_factor']; ah = d['high'] * d['adj_factor']; al = d['low'] * d['adj_factor']
out = np.sqrt(ah * al) - avwap
factor_dict.WQ_CLOSE_VWAP:
avwap = (d['amount'] / (d['vol'] + 1e-12)) * d['adj_factor']; ac = d['close'] * d['adj_factor']
out = (avwap - ac) / (avwap + ac)
factor_dict.WQ_OPEN_CLOSE:
ao = d['open'] * d['adj_factor']; ac = d['close'] * d['adj_factor']
out = -(1 - ao / ac)
factor_dict.WQ_VOLPRICE_DIV:
vol = d['vol']; ac = d['close'] * d['adj_factor']
out = np.sign(vol.diff(1)) * (-(ac - ac.shift(1)))
factor_dict.WQ_LOWPRICE_REV:
ac = d['close'] * d['adj_factor']; ao = d['open'] * d['adj_factor']; ah = d['high'] * d['adj_factor']; al = d['low'] * d['adj_factor']
out = (ac - al) * (ao ** 5) / ((al - ah) * (ac ** 5))
factor_dict.WQ_RANK_CORR_OV:
ao = d['open'] * d['adj_factor']; vol = d['vol']
out = -row_rank(ao).rolling(10).corr(row_rank(vol))
factor_dict.WQ_RANK_CORR_RV:
vol = d['vol']; ac = d['close'] * d['adj_factor']; ao = d['open'] * d['adj_factor']
out = -1 * (row_rank(np.log(vol + 1e-12).diff(2))).rolling(6).corr(row_rank((ac - ao) / ao))
factor_dict.WQ_SMA_DEV:

factor_dict.WQ_AMP_REV:
